deployed_chunk.source: measured from the recorded closed-loop runs, not assumed

a1_input_window.built_from: the stitched command stream the deployed switcher produces, not a chunk
a1_input_window.padding: frames past the playing chunk's end repeat its last frame; the host counts how often that happens

call_mode.stepwise: one call per 50 Hz control step, then the 20 ms residual low pass
call_mode.switch_event: one call per accepted chunk switch, with a linear residual crossfade over seam_crossfade_s triggered by the switch itself

triggers: the brain's own predicted close boundary
grasp_behaviour.on_exit: linear ramp back to the live residual over 150 ms
grasp_behaviour.never: the residual is never set to zero in a single control step

shared_cap.applies_to: anti-stall lookahead offset plus A1 residual, measured against raw K*
shared_cap.rule: project the vector sum onto the5cm ball; opposing residual/lookahead can cancel

lookahead_policy.note: when disabled, the independent post-switch stage strips the original lookahead; switching code is not altered

safety_fallback.recovery: after the fade the stage rejoins the live residual through the same ramp
safety_fallback.logged: each trigger is counted and the first step of each fade carries the counters

logging: per control step: raw K*, corrected command, measured keypoints, switch event, grasp phase, residual, total offset and fallback state
fingertips: the host wrapper passes every fingertip field through unchanged
